svg.text: Safety circuits – safety PLC, Category 3 / PL d
real design by a qualified designer
-A2 safety PLC (F-CPU + F-DI + F-DQ), PL e
EDM: mirror contacts (IEC 60947-4-1 Annex F) of -K1 and -K2 in series → F-DI10
-Y10 guard lock: power to unlock (spring locking)
F-DQ switch P and M (+24 V and 0 V of the load)
Category 3: two channels (T1/T2, A/B), test pulses detect short circuits and cross-faults,
discrepancy time 100 ms, EDM before every start, reset on release outside the cell.
Example: SF1 PFH_D = 8.0·10⁻⁸ /h → PL d (robot PL d); SF2 2.85·10⁻⁸ /h → PL e.
Safety distance S = 1600 mm/s · 0.215 s = 344 mm (ISO 13855).
